# mimecast_outbound_ip_addresses (Resource)

Manage the account-level Mimecast Cloud Gateway outbound IP address list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mimecast_outbound_ip_addresses" "account" {
  outbound_ip_addresses = ["203.0.113.10"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `outbound_ip_addresses` (Set of String) Canonical set of outbound IP addresses to assign for the account.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Singleton ID, always `outbound_ip_addresses`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mimecast_outbound_ip_addresses.account outbound_ip_addresses
```
